main_text.p: timè coactam, præsidibus & actionem dirigentibus iis, quibus id jus erat, summam rerum totius civitatis esse voluit Solon. Ea ex Solonis lege de Senatus actis judicabat, leges veteres recognoscebat, novas, si res posceret, ferebat, bella jubebat ac finiebat, pacemque reficiebat, magistratus majores, archontes, belli duces, hipparchos, navarchos plurefque alios creabat, fœdera feriebat, legatos edebat, & quò vellet, cum mandatis mittebat, civitatem exteris dabat, bene meritis præmia constituebat, judicia etiam quædam exercebat talium criminum, de quibus certæ leges non erant scriptæ: cujusmodi fuit εἰσαγγελίας, cujus accusatus damnatusque est Alcibiades. In hanc concionem universus populus ex eâdem Solonis lege coïbat sine ullo classium discrimine, etiam ii, qui erant classis imæ, habebantque omnes par suffragii jus. Locus concionis communiter erat aut forum aut Pnyx prope arcem fori instar, interdum etiam amplissimum theatrum Bacchi: ordinarium tempus dies tres stati in singulis prytaneis æqualiter feré inter se distantes, extraordinariarum pro rebus natis: illæ ἐκκλησίαι, hæ ἡ κατεκκλησίαι [?], aut συγκλησίαι ἐκ-

page.notes: The catchword "κλησίαι" completes the hyphenated word at the line end and is uncertain in its accents. The Greek words "κατεκκλησίαι" and "συγκλησίαι" are uncertain in their letters and accents at the scan's edge. The text is set in one continuous paragraph on this page. No marginal notes are printed.
